Ava / Redwood team,

Confirmed — Tue 9/15 13:00 PST works. For the priority list: our security review will focus on the following CAIQ domains first:
1) Network security / perimeter controls (A.1)
2) Identity & access management (I.2)
3) Data protection at rest / in transit (D.1 / D.2)
4) System change management (C.3)

Cheers,
